name: Much Bigger Than my Boyfriend
source:
They Bullied You in School. Now You Have Everything.
A new home, the girl you love, and the ring you've been saving for — you finally proposed, and life finally feels perfect. But the move brings you face to face with someone you tried hard to forget: the guy who bullied you all through school. He's still around. And he's not the only threat to your happiness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4718490/Much_Bigger_Than_my_Boyfriend/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
学生时代他们百般欺凌你；如今，你已拥有了一切。
温馨的新家、深爱的女孩，还有攒钱已久买下的钻戒——你终于求婚成功，生活似乎终于迎来了圆满。然而这次搬家，却让你与那个自己拼命想要遗忘的人打了个照面：那个整个学生时代都在霸凌你的家伙。他依然阴魂不散——而且，威胁你幸福生活的人还不止他一个。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4718490/Much_Bigger_Than_my_Boyfriend/]Steam[/url]]
